summary: basically a webmention occurs when Site A mentions Site B anywhere on the web. This then getsdisplayed as a comment on Site B. So the author of site A gets to own their comment and Site B displays the post as a comment. Works well for badges #PressEdConf19
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: basically a webmention occurs when Site A mentions Site B anywhere on the web. This then getsdisplayed as a comment on Site B. So the author of site A gets to own their comment and Site B displays the post as a comment. Works well for badges #PressEdConf19
